label: AD&D 2e — Planescape setting view (plane-scoped check kinds over the 2e base; sources are official TSR scans: CITE-ONLY, mechanics paraphrased with page witnesses)

notes: Limbo wizard casting test: roll-under the caster's Intelligence to cast ANY wizard spell on the plane (Planes of Chaos, TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66). Pass params {score: Int}.
Failure: the spell is lost from memory. Failed in the primal soup: a wild surge occurs automatically. Failed on stable terrain: wild surge only on a natural 20, otherwise no effect.
Natural 20 always fails AND sparks a wild surge regardless of terrain (reflow p72/book p68) — reported as fumble.

Wild-magic school riders (reflow p72/book p68): on a SUCCESSFUL wild-magic cast roll level variation (Tome of Magic table — not in corpus); in the soup roll level variation TWICE and apply the more extreme (tie: 1d6 picks); wild magic cast in the soup always sparks a surge even on success.
Priest spells are not subject to this test (reflow p68/book p64).

Outcome matrix identity: lkp:2e:limbo:spellcasting-outcomes (TABLE V). Law lane: Mechanus law:planar-conditions:limbo — school sub-ids (e.g. law:planar-conditions:limbo:divination) are synthesized by the accessor per the family _id_scheme. Ref upgraded from pending-M1 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06.

Limbo alteration drift (TABLE IV, Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66): when a spell that creates matter or changes shape/form SUCCEEDS (limbo_casting passed), roll 1d100 + spell level - caster level and read the band.
Pass params {spell_level, caster_level}. The exact result is the DM's, guided by the caster's intention.
Table identity lives here (its roll carries caster arithmetic a bare roll_table cannot); Mimir points used_at plane:limbo at this kind.

Miniflux upkeep check (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66): when a character reaches for an item unused for some time, the DM may call a Wisdom check — roll-under. Pass params {score: Wis}.
Failure: the item has drifted — dissolved or become something else (DM adjudicates). Worn clothes and constantly-handled possessions are maintained automatically by self-image.
Even stable regions of Limbo are subject to miniflux.
Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:limbo:miniflux (ref added by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06).

Pandemonium wind-madness save (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p88-89/book p84-85): save vs. paralyzation, cadence DM-called — typically daily; hourly in particularly noisy regions; none in shelter (sleep may still call one). Save targets are law: Mechanus/caller supplies {target}.
Failure: advance ONE stage on the four-stage track — 1 frustration, 2 despair, 3 hysteria, 4 resignation. Plane-dwellers sit at stage four.
Stage 1 frustration: -1 Wis and Int while exposed to the noise (modifier wind-madness-frustration).
Stage 2 despair: automatically surprised in combat; once able to act, +1 to attack and damage (modifier wind-madness-despair).
Stage 3 hysteria: on the failed save the sod runs amok for minutes equal to the margin of failure (target - total), then collapses helpless — no fighting or casting; in shelter behaves as stage 2.
Stage 4 resignation: a personal quirk/phobia/mania — roleplay, no fixed dice.

No permanent cure short of wish; symptoms remit off-plane and revert in full on return. Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:pandemonium:wind-madness (ref upgraded from pending-M5 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06). Stage-4 quirk menu: lkp:2e:pandemonium:everymans-madness.

River Styx ingestion save, Pandemonium headwaters (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p87/book p83): swallowing Styx water calls a save vs. spell. Save targets are law: Mechanus/caller supplies {target}.
Failure: the past life is forgotten entirely and permanently — spells, class abilities, alignment included.
SUCCESS STILL COSTS: the entire past day is forgotten.
In Pandemonium specifically, merely touching the water has no effect (deeper planes differ — their rows arrive with their books).
Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:lower-planes:styx-memory (ref added by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06).
The Wasting — contraction check, Oinos surface, the Gray Waste (Planes of Conflict Liber Malevolentiae, TSR 2615, reflow p53/book p51): 10% chance per day spent walking the layer's surface.
Progression is diceless: drains 1 point EACH from Str, Con, Dex, and Cha per day; death only when all four reach 0; cure disease ends it.
Realm exception: Abbathor's Glitterhell admits no disease (reflow p53).

Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:the-gray-waste:wasting-sickness (ref upgraded from pending-M5 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06). Hope-drain carries no stated dice in the witness — prose color, Mimir's lane.
